Case study · Brand Film

Kettlewell: 480k organic views from one shoot day

Produce a launch film that earns organic reach rather than being purely paid, and drive a measurable sales lift during launch week.

Client
Kettlewell
Year
2025
Timeline
1 week pre-pro
Services
5 delivered

Results

  • 480k Organic views
  • +29% Launch-week sales
  • 6 Platform cutdowns

Full case study

01

The challenge

A cast-iron cookware brand was launching a flagship pan against competitors spending ten times its budget. Their previous launch film was a clean studio product rotation that tested badly — viewers scrolled past it because it looked like an advertisement rather than something worth watching.

02

The goal

Produce a launch film that earns organic reach rather than being purely paid, and drive a measurable sales lift during launch week.

03

Approach

  1. 01 Rejected the studio approach and shot in a working bakery pre-service for genuine atmosphere.
  2. 02 Built the film around natural sound — flame, steel, pan — with almost no dialogue.
  3. 03 Deliberately graded warm and slightly underexposed so the audio leads the experience.
  4. 04 Cut a 75-second hero version plus six platform-specific cutdowns with different opening beats.
  5. 05 Released cutdowns on staggered days to extend the launch window rather than spending it all at once.
04

Services provided

  • Concept development
  • Single-day production
  • Sound design
  • Colour grade
  • Multi-format cutdowns
05

Results

The film accumulated 480,000 organic views in three weeks with no paid amplification behind the hero cut. Launch-week sales rose 29% against the previous release, and the cutdowns became the best-performing paid assets of the quarter.
